purpose: Exact whitelist of nanoda_lib 0.4.19 failure sites whose diagnostic counts as a semantic kernel rejection (sk_tool.classify_nanoda REJECTED). Anything not listed is ERROR or INCONCLUSIVE.
hash_rule: sha256 over the file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF; source_line is the exact line text
match_rule: panic: exit 101, exactly one panic header, thread main, location <file>:<line>:<col> with the path relative to the crate root (\ or /), the message line equal to `message`, no other non-blank stderr line except the RUST_BACKTRACE note, empty stdout; returned-error: exit 1, the first non-blank stderr line matching `message_regex`, followed only by nanoda's help line, empty stdout. The column is recorded and reported but not required.

sites.source_line: pub fn assert_def_eq(&mut self, u: ExprPtr<'t>, v: ExprPtr<'t>) { assert!(self.def_eq(u, v)) }

the same projection-from-Prop check of TypeChecker::infer_proj on an earlier, dependent field
